## 决策请求 · #33699 级联删除(epic #33631 R7)走哪种形状

Release: claim 6892276015 (session `session_01QsR2jRmmALkM1ftZxdVatQ`, branch `claude/area-A4-33699`) is withdrawn pending this decision. Nothing landed: the branch is empty at origin/main d7e1a5aa, no PR.
Governing text: epic #33631 ranked list 6889544281 row R7 (corrected 6889939163); maintainer pick 「R1 R7 R12 各一张+测量卡」.
Evidence: os-dev-report 6892420600 (bench run on SQLite + PostgreSQL at d7e1a5aa, statement-by-statement log).

**实测结论(卡片前提不成立):** 卡片的快路径条件「子对象没有逐行 hook」在标准内核上永远不成立。plugin-audit、plugin-sharing、service-storage、plugin-auth、plugin-approvals 都给每个对象的删除挂了 hook,所以按卡片原样实现,基准仍是 155 → 155 条 SQL。回收站的批量快照也早已实现(每个根一次读 + 一次写,ADR-0148 D1)。真正的成本是每个子记录 13 条 SQL:5 条权限读(每个子记录都把同一批父记录重读一遍)、1 条前像、1 条 DELETE、2 条审计、4 条共享清理。

| 选项 | 做法 | 效果 | 需要的裁决 / 代价 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A | 按卡片原样:子对象无删除侧 hook 时才走集合式 DELETE | 标准内核上 155 → 155,只在裸内核生效 | 多一条删除路径,加载插件就静默切换;零业务拉动 |
| B | 每个级联关系走现有的谓词删除通道:一次带范围的 id 读,逐行 hook 照常派发,`DELETE … WHERE id IN (…)` 每 500 条一批 | 估计约 50 条(未实测),每子记录 13 → ~2 | 四点要裁:实时事件逐行还是批量;安全等价(被拒的子记录必须让整个级联回滚,不能静默跳过,需 A2 复审);批量 hook 上限会新拒大级联;hook mode record → per-row。L 级,拆 A4 引擎卡 + A2 安全等价卡 |
| C | 行为全保留,只去重复读:c1 引擎合并三次同读(155 → 153);c2 一次级联内缓存父记录权限读(约 105) | 仍是每子记录线性 8 条 | c2 需要失效规则(hook 可能在级联中改父记录) |
| D | 以测量结案:在 epic 记下普查与分解,不立卡 | 无收益 | 大订单删除仍慢 |

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性:B 复用已验证的谓词删除通道,是 epic 要的集合式形状,不新增第二条删除路径;A 新增一条随插件静默切换的路径,长期要双份维护。
② 实际业务拉动:删除带几百行明细的订单今天是线性 SQL;A 在标准内核上零收益,B/C 才真正减少语句。
③ 防 AI 犯错:B 要求被拒的子记录响亮拒绝并回滚整个级联,而非静默跳过;A 让作者从元数据看不出走哪条路径。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:B 不新增能力位、不新增门禁;A 新增永久维护的第二路径。
Prior rulings read: `cascade`, `referentialCascadeDelete`, `predicate delete`, ADR-0148 in engine-cascade-planning.ts / recycle-bin/capture.ts → in-file rulings kept by every option; ADR-0148 D1; thread: none.

**推荐 B**(并入 c1)。只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否。若实时事件或安全等价两点裁定不利于 B,退回 C。
置信缺口:B 的约 50 条是估计,未实测;第一张实施卡先测。

**裁后执行:** 选 B ⇒ 区域按四点裁决拆两张卡(A4 引擎:级联走谓词删除通道 + c1;A2 安全等价:拒绝即回滚的等价钉子),各自走认领与复审。选 C ⇒ c1 + c2 一张 A4 卡、一张 A2 卡。选 D ⇒ 在 #33631 记普查后关闭本卡。

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Ruled: option B · the maintainer (Steedos) on the seat thread decision card (2026-11-15T10:39Z), answering the decision request 6892463174. Chosen option, verbatim as the card read: 「B: batch through the existing path」.

As it binds this card: each cascading relation goes through the existing predicate-delete arm (one scoped id read, per-row hooks kept, `DELETE … WHERE id IN (…)` in batches of 500), plus c1 (the engine merges its three identical reads).

The four points the request named are executed as **no observable change** (restoring the invariant, not a new product choice): (1) realtime keeps per-row events; (2) a refused child rolls back the whole cascade, never skipped; (3) no new refusal for a large cascade (the bulk hook ceiling must not refuse what deletes today); (4) record hooks still run per row. Premise for the dev to measure first: all four hold on the predicate arm. ⛔ If any one cannot hold, stop and report it as a fork back to this card; do not build around it and do not fall back to C silently.

Split per the request: an A4 engine card (cascade through the predicate arm + c1) and an A2 security-parity pin card, each claimed and reviewed on its own. The statement counts are estimates until the first card measures them.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (area S2 splits and re-claims).
